newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra names pensions agency chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra names pensions agency chief.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey on Thursday named career public servant Christine Goode as the new chief administrator of the public service pension fund.
Goode, 50, takes over her five-year appointment as Commissioner for Superannuation next month, Fahey said in a statement.
The position heads the administration of the government's pension fund, or superannuation, system for government workers.

Goode, a civil servant since 1968, had been chief executive officer of the Spectrum Management Agency since 1993 and had held various senior management positions in the departments of aviation, transport and communications.
